Run `git reset --soft HEAD~1`. Your changes stay staged.

messages.content: why is my kafka consumer lagging even though cpu is idle? 12 partitions, 3 consumers, max.poll.interval.ms default, handler does an http call per record

Likely the per-record synchronous HTTP call serialises you; with 4 partitions per consumer you are bound by round-trip latency, and slow calls can also exceed max.poll.interval.ms causing rebalances. Options: batch, async with bounded concurrency, or raise partitions/consumers.

messages.content: is it safe to run ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN note text on a 400M row postgres 14 table in prod
Yes on PG11+: adding a nullable column with no default is a catalog-only change and takes a brief ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock. Set lock_timeout so you do not queue behind long transactions.
